name: dsh-narrow-screen-fix
description: Unified narrow-screen (mobile) CSS adaptation for the dsh web GUI, replacing dsh-question-footer-fix / dsh-composer-send-fix / dsh-nav-tabs-scroll-fix. Fixes: question card + plan review footer overflow, send-button inset, top tab bar horizontal scroll, settings panel mobile stacking, directory browser columns, ssh panel tab bar. All via client-side style override — no dsh sources touched. 中文：DSH 窄屏适配统一插件（纯 client 覆盖样式）。
